entries.zh: 會；能、能夠（表能力或可能）
entries.en: can; to be able to (know how to do)
entries.notes: R 欄『che'』與「會」之官話音不合，疑欄位殘損或錯行，故義以 L『Poder』＋H「會」＋M ey 定。

entries.en: to be able to; can; to have the ability
to be able to accomplish; to be capable of
entries.notes: L 附記『cychọ it』殘損難辨，R『su hay』疑錯行，義依 H「克」之「能、勝任」義定。

entries.en: to prevail, to overcome; to be equal to (a task)
entries.notes: R 欄『sobxuyuya』殘損，以 H「勝」與 L『poder hazerse』之「能勝任／成事」通貫。

entries.zh: 堪；足以承受、擔當；可供（使用）
entries.en: to be fit for; to be able to bear; to be worth
entries.notes: L 詞尾 s 存疑（provecho/provechos 義同，於義無損），H「堪」取「堪用、足以」義。

entries.en: usable; fit for use; serviceable
fit to be; can serve as

entries.zh: 會做得；可以做到、做得成
entries.en: can be done; it is possible to do
entries.notes: M 欄『ter』疑為『tit』（得）之殘讀，H「會做得」於義已明。

entries.zh: 事諧；事情辦得成、諸事順遂
entries.en: the matter succeeds; things turn out well
entries.notes: 「事諧」係 L『poder hazerse』（事可成）之意譯而非逐字對譯，故降一級。

entries.zh: 有法伊奈何；有法子對付他、奈何得了他
entries.en: to have a way to deal with him; to be able to handle someone
to despise, to slight, to scorn
entries.notes: H 疑『貌／藐』，依 L『menospreciar』與 M bian 定為「藐」。

entries.zh: 乞得；求而得之、如願求得
entries.en: to obtain by asking; to get what one wishes for
entries.notes: L『desear』與 H「乞得」義稍隔，須以「求而可得」通貫，故降一級。

entries.zh: 財力；有財有勢、財勢雄厚
entries.en: wealth and power; powerful in means
to bully, to oppress; to get the better of
entries.notes: L 為形容詞『poderoso』而 H「欺過」為動詞，以「能以勢壓人」通貫，義有推斷。

entries.en: pus; purulent matter (Sp. podre)
entries.notes: L『Pode』當為『Podre』之省寫，M lang 正合「膿」之閩南讀，然 H 存『膿／腴』之疑。

entries.en: eczema; moist sores of the hands and feet
rotten; decayed; mushy

entries.zh: 厭（本義飽足、厭棄；於「腐爛」義不洽，存疑）
entries.en: to be satiated, to be weary of (sense with 'rotten' doubtful)
entries.notes: H「厭」與 L『podrido』不密合，M『aihu』待考，未敢遽定其腐敗義。

entries.zh: 攬（摟取、把持；與「腐爛」義不合，疑字訛）
entries.en: to grasp, to embrace (character doubtful; does not fit 'rotten')
entries.notes: H 疑『攬／覽』二讀皆無腐敗義，M lam 或借為閩南 lám（敗壞、不中用），未能定。

entries.en: rotten and stinking; decayed

entries.zh: 靡（疑為「糜」之形訛，糜爛即腐爛）
entries.en: rotten, mushy (perh. 糜 'to turn to mush')
entries.notes: H 疑『靡／縻』皆無腐爛義，疑係「糜」之訛，M by 可通「糜」之閩南讀。
